title: Company priority decomp and staffing simulator: Q3 quick-run
body:
Purpose
-----
Quick working doc to: 1) decompose top-level company priorities into measurable team slices for Q3, 2) run simple staffing scenarios and show impact (fast sim for leadership), and 3) propose an all-hands run-of-show + breakout templates to make alignment concrete. This is intentionally rough — goal is to get leadership feedback by EOW and then push a polished version for the all-hands pre-read.

Context / constraints
-------------------
- We are in a growth-of-inference phase: product needs to balance throughput, latency, and unit economics. Team size ~150, hiring rate constrained by budget planning in CS/Finance.
- Priorities surfaced from exec triage: Hosted API reliability, Dedicated GA stabilization, Private onboarding pilot, Optimize toolkit launch. Each priority competes for Eng, SRE, and Solutions cycles.
- Timeline: Q3 planning cycle: finalize OKRs by 2026-02-20; all-hands to socialize on 2026-02-26.

Executive summary (one-paragraph)
--------------------------------
Proposed Q3 focus is: (A) secure production reliability for Hosted API and Dedicated (SLOs + incident runway), (B) commercialize Private deployment early-adopter path, and (C) deliver Redwood Optimize minimal feature set (batching/caching suggestions + model guidance). To hit these with current headcount, we recommend prioritizing reliability work (A) with a guarded runway for Private pilot (B) and a lean Optimize MVP (C). The attached staffing simulator shows two staffing allocations with tradeoffs (time-to-GA, risk).

Top-level candidate company OKRs (draft)
--------------------------------------
Objective 1 — Production inference reliability: Trustworthy everywhere
KR1.1: Reduce 95th-percentile tail latency for Hosted API (text-gen common paths) by 20% vs baseline
KR1.2: Achieve <1.0% critical incident rate month-to-month for Dedicated clusters (measured by incidents causing customer RTO breaches)
KR1.3: Ship automatic fallback routing policy to backup model variants and rollouts for top 3 customer flows

Objective 2 — Private & enterprise readiness: Make private safe and fast to adopt
KR2.1: Complete 3 enterprise Private onboarding pilots with documented runbooks and postmortems
KR2.2: Add KMS/HSM end-to-end integration checklist and pass 2 compliance readiness audits internally
KR2.3: Reduce Private deployment time-to-first-inference by 30% (measured from deployment start to first successful inference)

Objective 3 — Unit economics & optimize toolkit: cheaper inference, same quality
KR3.1: Roll out Optimize recommendations (batching, caching presets) with pilot customers and report 10% avg token-cost reduction for pilot set
KR3.2: Deliver model recommendation engine prototype (doc + heuristics) for 5 common workloads
KR3.3: Establish monitoring and regression alerts for Quality vs baseline on 4 benchmark prompts

How these map to teams (coarse)
--------------------------------
- Eng: serving-runtime, platform-engineering = lead on Objective 1 (latency, kernel selection), support for Objective 3 (optimize hooks)
- SRE: observability, runbooks, incident playbooks = critical for KR1.2 and canonical incident lessons
- Solutions & Professional Services: lead for Objective 2 pilots + onboarding materials
- Product + Devex: run Optimize pilot program, instrumentation, and customer-facing docs

Staffing simulator (fast scenarios) — assumptions and outputs
----------------------------------------------------------
Assumptions (simplified):
- Core engineering capacity units: total 120 engineer-weeks available across Eng + SRE + Solutions in Q3 sprint window (net of leave and hiring).
- Baseline expected scope to hit all KRs if fully staffed: 140 engineer-weeks (i.e., shortfall).
- Hiring pipeline uncertain: we may onboard 8 ICs mid-Q3 if approvals clear (adds ~40 engineer-weeks effective).

Scenario A — Reliability-first (recommended)
- Allocation: 60% Eng/SRE to Objective 1, 25% to Objective 2 pilot, 15% to Objective 3
- Outcome: High confidence on KR1.1/1.2/1.3; Private pilot likely constrained (1–2 pilots, slower onboarding); Optimize MVP scope reduced (prototype, no customer rollout)
- Risk: slower commercial expansion for Private buyers; potential missed revenue opportunities but lower customer churn risk.

Scenario B — Balanced push (higher commercial focus)
- Allocation: 45% Eng/SRE to Objective 1, 35% to Objective 2, 20% to Objective 3
- Outcome: Private pilot velocity higher (3 pilots targeted), but KR1 tail-latency reduction may miss target by EOY; higher operational risk for Hosted API during peak loads
- Risk: potential incident tailbacks and higher SRE on-call load

Quick sim outputs (high-level)
- Scenario A: Probable success on Objective 1 = 85%, Objective 2 = 40%, Objective 3 = 35%
- Scenario B: Probable success on Objective 1 = 55%, Objective 2 = 70%, Objective 3 = 50%

Proposed all-hands run-of-show (90 minutes)
------------------------------------------
1) Exec framing (12 min): CEO one-paragraph recap of mission + Q3 thesis. Primary ask: alignment on priorities and tradeoffs.
2) Product-state highlight (12 min): short demo of Optimize MVP heuristics + Hosted API reliability dashboard snapshot
3) Staffing & scenarios (10 min): present the staffing simulator and ask for decision (Scenario A vs B)
4) Breakouts (30 min total across rooms): structured by cross-functional owner — each group runs a 20-min discussion + 10-min synthesis back; templates below.
5) Decision & next steps (10 min): leadership states chosen scenario and immediate puts b/lines for team leads
6) AMA + wrap (16 min): open floor, capture 3 top unresolved questions to follow up asynchronously

Breakout templates (to run asynchronously or during all-hands)
-----------------------------------------------------------
Breakout goal: turn top-level OKRs into explicit team commitments and immediate blockers. Use this template:
- Quick intro (2 min): name, team, 1-line current focus
- Commitment proposed (3 min): one team-level owner + 1 measurable outcome for Q3 (e.g., reduce model latency for 512 tokens by 15%)
- Blockers & dependencies (7 min): list (SRE needs, data access, infra capacity, hiring)
- 30-day success markers (3 min): what success looks like at month 1
- Scribe captures owner + Slack channel/PR link

Decision log (to be captured live)
--------------------------------
- Decision 1 (staffing scenario): proposed Scenario A recommended; leadership to confirm by 2026-02-18
- Decision 2 (all-hands cadence): move to monthly 60-min technical deep-dive after this town; product to schedule

Open questions & unknowns (for leadership)
---------------------------------------
- Q: If we pick Scenario A, can Sales/CS defer some Private pilot SLAs to Enterprise Sales readiness to reduce immediate eng load? (owner: VP Sales)
- Q: What is the budget gating for hiring 8 ICs mid-Q3? Finance to confirm by 2026-02-17 (owner: VP Finance)
- Q: Is there appetite to extend Dedicated GA timeline by 2 sprints to reduce infra churn? (owner: CTO)

Risks & mitigations (fast list)
-----------------------------
- Risk: Increased incidents if we de-prioritize platform changes. Mitigation: enforce stricter canary windows + automatic fallback routing (KR1.3).
- Risk: Private pilot failures causing sales friction. Mitigation: narrow pilot scope to 3 carefully selected accounts and run integration championing with Solutions eng.
- Risk: Optimize recommendations accidentally reduce perceived quality (wrong quantization choice). Mitigation: default to conservative presets + regression alerts for quality (KR3.3).

Immediate next steps (this week)
------------------------------
- THU 2026-02-12: Leadership review comments due (Aisha consolidates)
- FRI 2026-02-13: Share final draft OKR doc for exec sign-off
- MON 2026-02-16: All-hands pre-read + breakout assignment posted to Slack + Confluence
- WED 2026-02-18: Leadership confirm staffing scenario and hiring ask to Finance

Notes to self / rough TODOs
-------------------------
- Add simple visualization of the staffing simulator outputs (heatmap) — will create a quick sheet if leadership wants visuals.
- Cross-link the SLO definitions page (Confluence) and the Dedicated GA checklist PR.
- Get Solutions to pre-select 3 pilot customers and draft intake form by EOD Friday.

Appendix (short references)
--------------------------
- Baseline latency metrics: hosted-api/latency-dashboard (linked in Confluence)
- Incident taxonomy doc: SRE/incident-taxonomy-v2
- Hiring pipeline: People Ops tracker (internal)

End of draft. Please ping me in #ops-priority if you want edits live during the leadership sync.
